title: Login issue
description: Customer is unable to log in to their account using the correct email and password.

title: Payment failed
description: The customer tried to make a payment but the transaction failed unexpectedly.

title: Unable to reset password
description: Customer requested a password reset but did not receive the reset email.

title: Account verification problem
description: Customer cannot complete the account verification process.

title: Refund not received
description: Customer requested a refund several days ago but has not received the money yet.

title: Profile update issue
description: Customer is unable to update their phone number and address from the profile settings.

title: Order status not updated
description: The order has already been delivered but the status still shows as processing.

title: Website loading slowly
description: Customer reports that several pages are taking too long to load.

title: Incorrect billing amount
description: Customer was charged a different amount than the price shown during checkout.

title: Email notification not received
description: Customer is not receiving important email notifications from the system.

title: Mobile app crashing
description: The mobile application closes unexpectedly when the customer opens the dashboard.

title: Subscription cancellation issue
description: Customer is unable to cancel their current subscription from the account settings.

title: Missing order item
description: One item from the customer's order was missing from the delivered package.

title: Dark mode not working
description: Customer reports that the dark mode option does not apply correctly across the website.

title: Two-factor authentication issue
description: Customer cannot receive the verification code required for two-factor authentication.
